### Caesars Palace Earns Three Gold Honors in 2026 Travel Weekly Magellan Awards


11/16/2026


[Download this Press Release (opens in new window) PDF 501 KB](https://s202.q4cdn.com/508919455/files/doc_news/Caesars-Palace-Earns-Three-Gold-Honors-in-2026-Travel-Weekly-Magellan-Awards-2026.pdf)

**Key Facts**


- THE VILLAS Caesars Palace received a Gold Magellan Award in the Luxury (Five-Star) Villa Design category.
- The Octavius Sky Villas received a Gold Magellan Award in the Luxury (Five-Star) Penthouse Design category.
- The Colosseum Presidential Villas received a Gold Magellan Award in the Luxury (Five-Star) Presidential Suite category.


LAS VEGAS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


THE VILLAS Caesars Palace, the Octavius Sky Villas and the Colosseum Presidential Villas at Caesars Palace each earned Gold honors in the 2026 Travel Weekly Magellan Awards, recognizing excellence across the travel and hospitality industry.


THE VILLAS Caesars Palace received a Gold Magellan Award in the Luxury (Five-Star) Villa Design category, while the Octavius Sky Villas earned Gold in the Luxury (Five-Star) Penthouse Design category and the Colosseum Presidential Villas won Gold in the Luxury (Five-Star) Presidential Suite category. Together, the three award-winning accommodations represent distinct luxury offerings at Caesars Palace, ranging from the exclusive six-villa collection of THE VILLAS Caesars Palace to the penthouse-style Octavius Sky Villas and residential-style Colosseum Presidential Villas.


“It is incredibly rewarding to see three of our luxury accommodations recognized by Travel Weekly,” said Sean McBurney, Chief Commercial Officer and Regional President of Caesars Entertainment. “These honors speak to the strength of our luxury portfolio at Caesars Palace, from THE VILLAS, which have long been among our most sought-after offerings, to the recently transformed Colosseum Presidential Villas and Octavius Sky Villas.”


The Travel Weekly Magellan Awards recognize outstanding achievement across the travel industry, honoring excellence in hospitality, destinations, cruise lines, airlines, travel advisors, tour operators and transportation. Entries are evaluated individually against a standard of excellence by a panel of accomplished travel industry professionals.


“Year after year, the Magellan Awards showcase the very best of travel industry creativity and innovation,” said Johanna Jainchill, editor-in-chief of Travel Weekly. “Yet each year brings something new — fresh ideas, bold execution and work that challenges our expectations of what great travel marketing can be.”


**THE VILLAS Caesars Palace Earns Gold Magellan Award for Luxury (Five-Star) Villa Design**


THE VILLAS Caesars Palace showcases architectural grandeur and timeless luxury in the heart of the Las Vegas Strip. The exclusive collection of villas offers a private arrival experience separate from the main resort and has welcomed a distinguished roster of guests, from celebrities to dignitaries and royalty. In October 2026, THE VILLAS Caesars Palace ranked Number 1 on AAA’s inaugural Top 10 Casino Hotels list and retained its coveted AAA Five Diamond designation.


Each villa is thoughtfully curated around a distinct design theme, blending classical influences with contemporary luxury. Imported marble walls and flooring, hand-painted murals and layered textures create a sense of opulence throughout the interiors.


The expansive layouts include grand hallways, formal dining rooms, elegant living spaces and private outdoor patios overlooking the Garden of the Gods Pool Oasis. Formal tables anchor each dining room, while a majestic piano sits in the adjacent living area. Select villas feature billiard rooms, full bars and media rooms with theater-style seating and massage chairs. Jetted spa tubs and private plunge pools extend the experience outdoors, creating a secluded retreat.


**Octavius Sky Villas at Caesars Palace Earn Gold Magellan Award for Luxury (Five-Star) Penthouse Design**


Caesars Palace unveiled 29 completely redesigned Octavius Sky Villas in January 2026, redefining elevated luxury on the Las Vegas Strip. Located on the top two floors of the Octavius Tower and designed by Peter Silling & Associates, the Sky Villas appeal to a new generation of high-end travelers, seamlessly blending contemporary architecture with modern comfort. Available in one-, two- and three-bedroom layouts, each villa offers sweeping views of the city and a modern residential aesthetic.


Soaring ceilings and sleek wall treatments create an airy living space, balanced by blue velvet and rich brown leather. A sculptural chandelier anchors the dining area, while a large TV and full bar create a setting for entertaining. Gold metal, dark wood and contemporary artwork add contrast and character throughout the interiors.


**Colosseum Presidential Villas at Caesars Palace Earn Gold Magellan Award for Luxury (Five-Star) Presidential Suite**


The newly transformed Colosseum Presidential Villas represent the pinnacle of residential-style luxury at Caesars Palace, pairing extraordinary scale and privacy with a storied legacy of hosting U.S. presidents, world leaders, dignitaries and celebrated figures.


The space comprises two expansive villas, each with a 1,700-square-foot private terrace overlooking the Las Vegas skyline. The villas can seamlessly connect to create more than 19,000 square feet of indoor and outdoor living space and are accessible exclusively via a private elevator.


Designed by Peter Silling & Associates, the Colosseum Presidential Villas balance European artistry and the modern grandeur synonymous with Caesars Palace. A grand central hallway anchors each villa, while preserved architectural elements, including stately marble pillars, pay homage to their heritage. Floor-to-ceiling windows fill the interiors with natural light, and custom chandeliers serve as focal points. One villa features gold accents and soft lighting, while the other embraces bolder, darker tones.

**FAQs (Frequently Asked Questions)**


**What are the Travel Weekly Magellan Awards?**


The Travel Weekly Magellan Awards recognize excellence across the travel industry, with submissions reviewed and judged by experienced professionals from across the travel and hospitality sectors.


**How are Travel Weekly Magellan winners selected?**


Magellan Award recipients are selected by a panel of top travel professionals. In determining winners, entries do not compete with one another but are judged against a standard of excellence based on Travel Weekly's long experience.


**When were the Octavius Sky Villas and Colosseum Presidential Villas unveiled?**


The newly renovated Octavius Sky Villas and Colosseum Presidential Villas at Caesars Palace were unveiled in January 2026.


**What distinguishes THE VILLAS Caesars Palace from the Octavius Sky Villas and Colosseum Presidential Villas?**


THE VILLAS Caesars Palace is a collection of six luxury villas featuring expansive indoor and outdoor living spaces overlooking the Garden of the Gods Pool Oasis. The Octavius Sky Villas offer penthouse-style accommodations atop the Octavius Tower, while the Presidential Villas in the Colosseum Tower pair residential-style living with rooftop terraces and panoramic views of the Las Vegas Strip.


**What amenities are available at THE VILLAS Caesars Palace?**


THE VILLAS Caesars Palace is accessible through a private entrance. Guests enjoy private airport transportation, dedicated butler service, personalized concierge assistance, gourmet in-villa dining and access to exclusive amenities. Select villas also feature private elevators, plunge pools, media rooms and direct access to the Garden of the Gods Pool Oasis.


**How many Octavius Sky Villas are available at Caesars Palace?**


Caesars Palace offers 29 Octavius Sky Villas on the top two floors of the Octavius Tower.


**How many Colosseum Presidential Villas are available at Caesars Palace?**


Caesars Palace offers two Colosseum Presidential Villas, which can remain separate or connect to create one expansive living space.


**What villas are included in THE VILLAS Caesars Palace?**


THE VILLAS Caesars Palace comprises six exclusive luxury villas: Claudius Villa, Marcus Aurelius Villa, Constantine Villa, Hadrian Villa, Titus Villa and Trajan Villa.


**How can guests book THE VILLAS Caesars Palace?**


Guests can learn more and book accommodations at[caesars.com/suites/las-vegas/villas](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fcaesars.com%2Fsuites%2Flas-vegas%2Fvillas&esheet=54641754&newsitemid=20261116920956&lan=en-US&anchor=caesars.com%2Fsuites%2Flas-vegas%2Fvillas&index=6&md5=9750e98957a79516adb019389a16d8f1) .


**How can guests book the Octavius Sky Villas or Colosseum Presidential Villas at Caesars Palace?**


Guests can book the Octavius Sky Villas or the Colosseum Presidential Villas at[caesars.com/suites/las-vegas](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caesars.com%2Fsuites%2Flas-vegas&esheet=54641754&newsitemid=20261116920956&lan=en-US&anchor=caesars.com%2Fsuites%2Flas-vegas&index=7&md5=ef75dac5cab1228cde0045c515bb7b77) .


**About Caesars Palace**


Caesars Palace, the iconic Las Vegas Strip resort where every guest is treated like a Caesar, features 3,980 hotel guest rooms and[suites](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caesars.com%2Flas-vegas%2Fsuites&esheet=54641754&newsitemid=20261116920956&lan=en-US&anchor=suites&index=8&md5=09d89a271a167b0e8afc59224a74ab79) , including the redesigned 182-room[Nobu Hotel Caesars Palace](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caesars.com%2Fnobu-caesars-palace&esheet=54641754&newsitemid=20261116920956&lan=en-US&anchor=Nobu+Hotel+Caesars+Palace&index=9&md5=a0165178cbc6b05c0d617839964dca23) , the renovated Colosseum Tower and[THE VILLAS Caesars Palace](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caesars.com%2Fsuites%2Flas-vegas%2Fvillas&esheet=54641754&newsitemid=20261116920956&lan=en-US&anchor=THE+VILLAS+Caesars+Palace&index=10&md5=73e92ec7c2c39f95ba48422fd40d77bb) , which has earned the prestigious AAA Five Diamond rating. Both Caesars Palace and Nobu Hotel Caesars Palace have also received AAA Four Diamond designations. The 85-acre resort offers diverse dining options from the award-winning Bacchanal Buffet to celebrity chef-branded restaurants, including Gordon Ramsay HELL’S KITCHEN, Pronto by Giada, Amalfi by Bobby Flay, Vanderpump Cocktail Garden by restaurateur and television star Lisa Vanderpump, one of Nobu Matsuhisa’s largest Nobu restaurants, MICHELIN-starred Restaurant Guy Savoy, award-winning pastry chef Dominique Ansel’s first Las Vegas bakery, Stanton Social Italian – a dining concept in partnership with Tao Group Hospitality, legendary New York Steak House Peter Luger and Brasserie B Parisian Steakhouse by Bobby Flay. The Celebrity Food Hall features Guy Fieri’s Chicken Guy!, Bobby’s Burgers by Bobby Flay, Tortazo by Rick Bayless, Buddy V’s Pizzeria and Mokbar by Esther Choi. For the best in cocktails, destination lounges include Montecristo Cigar Bar, VISTA Cocktail Lounge, Stadia Bar and Caspian’s – a cocktail and caviar bar with Clique Hospitality. The resort also features nearly 130,000 square feet of casino space, the Caesars Race & Sportsbook at Caesars Palace with a 143-foot HD LED screen and state-of-the-art sound, a five-acre Garden of the Gods Pool Oasis, the luxurious Qua Baths & Spa, Hairdreams by Michael Boychuck, five wedding chapels and gardens, the 75,000-square-foot OMNIA Nightclub and OMNIA Dayclub & Skybar on Las Vegas Boulevard. The 4,300-seat Colosseum is the most celebrated venue in Las Vegas with an impressive legacy of superstar talent featured in an intimate, once-in-a-lifetime setting. The Colosseum currently spotlights world-class entertainers, including LISA, Cyndi Lauper, Mötley Crüe, Sting, Tim McGraw and Rod Stewart. Also, the Green Fairy Garden in front of Caesars Palace hosts ABSINTHE by Spiegelworld, an adults-only circus variety show featuring a cocktail of wild and outlandish acts. The Forum Shops at Caesars Palace showcases more than 160 boutiques and restaurants. Caesars Palace is operated by a subsidiary of Caesars Entertainment, Inc. (NASDAQ: CZR).
